newsitem.title: SWEDEN: NorScan pulp stocks rose 200,000 t in Oct - paper.
newsitem.headline: NorScan pulp stocks rose 200,000 t in Oct - paper.

text.p: NorScan pulp stocks rose by 200,000 tonnes in October from the September level of 1.73 million tonnes, Swedish financial daily Finanstidningen reported on Thursday.
The inventories figure, expected to be announced this week, measures pulp stocks in the North American and Scandinavian (NorScan) countries which together account for 65 percent of world production.

"Higher stocks mean greater pressure and a risk that pulp prices which have just started rising may drift down again," the paper said, adding that forestry companies might have to wait longer for an upturn in their fortunes.
